transcript.text: his Excellency Mr Fernando Zavala chairman of the APAC CEO Summit 2024 and former prime minister of Peru distinguished panelists distinguish delegates from Indonesia all the ministers attending I would like also to acknowledge the presence of many notable CEOs from Latin America and the Caribbean and distinguished participants from the Asian Asian business advisory Council ladies and gentlemen uh I'm very honored to be invited to address this distinguished body as we all know that uh peace and prosperity is driven by economic activity by the role of the business Community the role of entrepreneurs the role of Industry uh without the dynamic participation of the economic sector basically we cannot have growth and Prosperity without growth we cannot alleviate poverty we cannot create relevant employment therefore I am very happy and very honored to address you the drivers of economic growth in the Pacific region the Pacific region I think is one of the most dynamic areas of the world uh economic growth potential technological achievements the demographics the resources available in the Pacific and the indopacific regions all point to a bright economic future for all we have at the present geopolitical tension but I am an optimist in the interests of humanity I believe that the leaders of the great powers of the world in the final analysis will always opt for the common good rivalry is historical there will always be rivalry but our planet has become smaller we are now in a planet full of technological breakthroughs the tremendous breakthroughs and Technology demands that leaders be more wise be more patient be more accommodating because the power of Technology can bring significant progress to human life but the power of technology technology can also destroy human life very fast therefore I always choose the path of collaboration engage M communication negotiation yes we have to uphold and live by Common laws by International rules but we
